entities.summary: Cui Yongxi, also known as Jacky Cui, is a Chinese professional basketball player who plays for the Guangdong Southern Tigers of the CBA. He is also a member of the China men's national basketball team. Yongxi previously played for the Brooklyn Nets of the National Basketball Association during the 2024–25 NBA season where he only appeared in five regular season games.
